in_marathi.name: Meganathan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Meganathan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Meganathan is a combination of two Tamil words - 'Megam' which means great, and 'Anathan' which means God. So, Meganathan can be translated to 'Mighty God'.

in_bengali.name: Meganathan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Mighty God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Meganathan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Meganathan is a combination of two Tamil words - 'Megam' which means great, and 'Anathan' which means God. So, Meganathan can be translated to 'Mighty God'.
